'''Tsheyk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who owned a game reserve on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" />
